Sergio / Jonas,

I reviewed Aurelia's RFP and the redlined term sheet. Summary of decision: conditional executive approval. Conditions are below — we should treat these as deal-level controls required before I sign: 

1) Price lock: Approve 36-month price lock at current quoted rates.
2) Uplift cap: Approve a 3% maximum year-over-year uplift. No additional market-driven uplift will be permitted without a joint review and finance sign-off.
3) Renewal protection: Approve 12-month renewal protection option, but limit to a single renewal term and require at least 60 days' written notice.
4) Escrow / auto-review: Add a defined threshold clause — if total infra costs increase >7% in any 12-month period attributable to third-party hardware/cloud cost shifts, Redwood can request an emergency review; this triggers a 30-day negotiation period and allows a one-time uplift up to 5% (with documented cost evidence).
5) Commercial guardrail: Commit to minimum annual committed ARR floor of $12M across the contract (if usage drops below the floor, auto-reconciliation applies).
6) Legal: require SOC 2 Type II within 30 days and an indemnity cap tied to limits already approved on similar deals; Legal will circulate final redlines.

If Jonas confirms finance can tolerate the downside scenarios under item 4 and item 5 is contractualized, I will sign the addendum. I attached a 1-page summary to circulate to Deal Desk and Finance (approved_term_summary.docx).

Kimberly Park
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
